summary: Confirmed on the Forest Service page and recreation.gov: $10 single / $20 double (fees already recorded at $10, high raised to $20), first-come only (overrides the inherited recreation.gov reservable row), 14-day max, 5 paved-spur sites, no hookups, vault toilet, no dump. Drinking water left unrecorded (rec.gov hand pump vs FS 'not available'). Not stated: rig length, season (the rec.gov FCFS season Apr 3 - Oct 31, 2026 is a rate season). Gauley Ranger District runs it; no concessioner named. Note unchanged.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the entry's waterfront is 'riverfront' but its own --AWH note says 'across the road from the Cranberry River. Sites are not waterfront.'; recreation.gov says 'adjacent to the Cranberry River'.
Inherited federal booking row (reservable via recreation.gov, 180-day window) is wrong here; this result overrides it with first-come only.

Road caveat (not a closure of the campground): Forest Order 09-21-02-26-05 closes FR 76 section 1 (38.2622,-80.5191 to 38.2862,-80.5323), between Richwood and Big Rock, from Sept 8 to Nov 20, 2026, so the FS directions from Richwood are blocked; the Forest Service says Big Rock stays reachable 'via FR 101 and CR46/2 near Dyer, WV ... from the north route'. Gauley RD (304) 846-2695.
Criteria (soft): no site length posted by either page; the FS limit 'one wheeled camping unit only, defined as motorhome or travel trailer' implies RVs are expected.
